Metadata.Name: Form Collection Workflow
Metadata.Description: Collects data via a form, routes to human review, then updates the database based on reviewer decisions.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Collect Information
Step.Description: User submits data through the collection form

Step.Title: Review Submission
Step.Description: A staff member reviews the submitted data for accuracy
Step.Definition: {"assigned_group_id":"group-staff","form_id":"form-1","description":"Review this submission and approve or request changes.","routes":[{"expression":"review_result == 'approved'","target_step_id":"step-3"},{"expression":"review_result == 'changes_needed'","target_step_id":"step-4"}],"default_target_step_id":"step-4"}

Step.Title: Save to Database
Step.Description: Insert approved data into the target table

Step.Title: Request Changes
Step.Description: Notify the submitter that changes are needed
Step.Definition: {"to":"$input.submitter_email","subject":"Changes Requested","body":"Your submission requires changes. Please review and resubmit.","next_step_ids":[]}

Step.Title: Confirm Completion
Step.Description: Send confirmation that the submission was processed
Step.Definition: {"to":"$input.submitter_email","subject":"Submission Processed","body":"Your submission has been approved and saved successfully.","next_step_ids":[]}

Form.name: Information Collection Form
Form.Description: A general-purpose data collection form for gathering information that requires human review.

Group.name: Staff
Group.Description: Staff members authorized to review and process form submissions.
